Home.title: Care, scheduled with clarity
Home.description: Book specialists, manage availability, and keep clinical history secure.

Auth.loginSubtitle: Access as patient, specialist, or admin.
Auth.registerSubtitle: Pick your role. Specialists stay pending until an admin approves them.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this dashboard.
errors.specialistFields: Fill specialty and license before using Google.
errors.emailNotVerified: Activate your account from the verification email first.
errors.invalidEmail: That email doesn’t look valid. Check the format (e.g. name@email.com).
errors.userDisabled: This account is disabled. Contact support.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.emailInUse: An account with that email already exists. Sign in or use another email.
errors.weakPassword: That password is too weak. Use at least 6 characters.
errors.popupClosed: The Google window was closed before finishing.
errors.network: Connection problem. Check your internet and try again.

VerifyEmail.title: Activate your account
VerifyEmail.subtitle: We sent a link to {email}. Open it, then tap “I’ve verified”.

Dashboard.patientBody: Book appointments as a patient. Specialists can use this panel too.
Dashboard.specialistBody: Complete your specialist profile to operate on the platform.
Dashboard.pendingBody: An admin must verify your credentials before you appear in the directory and manage appointments.
Dashboard.rejectedBody: Your specialist application was rejected. Contact an admin if you think this is a mistake.
Dashboard.activeBody: Account active · {specialty}. You can register patients and book on their behalf.
Dashboard.adminBody: Review patients, approve specialist applications, and test emails. The «admin» button in the header opens this panel.

Promote.title: Become a specialist
Promote.subtitle: Request verification. You stay pending until an admin approves.
Promote.success: Application sent. Check the specialist panel.

Clinic.filesPickPatient: Pick a patient under Schedule to view their clinical history and documents.
Clinic.registerSubtitle: Create a patient account. Save the temporary password to share with them.
Clinic.registerPhoneHint: Phone is saved to the clinical history. The patient should complete the rest.
Clinic.bookSubtitle: Search the patient and click a free slot in the week grid.
Clinic.calHint: Green = available · gray = outside hours · red = busy. Click a free slot.
Clinic.calPast: You can’t book a day or time that already passed.
Clinic.bookNeedPatient: Select a patient before creating the appointment.
Clinic.bookNeedSlot: Select a free slot on the calendar.
Clinic.bookNeedBoth: Select a patient and a free slot on the calendar.
Clinic.bookReady: Ready: patient and slot selected. You can create the appointment.
Clinic.transferSubtitle: The other specialist confirms via the bell and gets email if Resend is configured.

Schedule.title: Working hours
Schedule.subtitle: Pick workdays and time ranges (the gap between ranges is lunch).
Schedule.slotMinutesHint: Calendar click step (15 min–2 h). You can still change it in the modal.

GoogleCalendar.title: Your Google Calendar
GoogleCalendar.subtitle: Yelena won’t offer times when you’re already busy, and can create a Meet link when someone books.
GoogleCalendar.step2: Sign in with the Google account you use for your work calendar (Gmail / Workspace).
GoogleCalendar.step3: When Google asks, allow access to view and edit your calendar.
GoogleCalendar.step4: You’ll return here automatically. If you see your email, you’re done.
GoogleCalendar.benefit1: Busy times on Google won’t show as available.
GoogleCalendar.benefit2: New appointments are saved to your Google Calendar.
GoogleCalendar.benefit3: When Google allows it, a Meet link is created for the patient.
GoogleCalendar.privacyNote: We only use your calendar for bookings. You can disconnect anytime.
GoogleCalendar.notConfigured: This feature isn’t turned on for the clinic yet. Ask whoever manages Yelena.
GoogleCalendar.connectedHint: Your schedule is syncing. To switch accounts, disconnect and connect again.
GoogleCalendar.connectSuccess: Done — your Google Calendar is connected.
GoogleCalendar.connectError: We couldn’t connect to Google. Try again or use another account.
GoogleCalendar.disconnectSuccess: Calendar disconnected. Existing Google events are not deleted.
GoogleCalendar.disconnectError: We couldn’t disconnect. Please try again.
GoogleCalendar.statusError: We couldn’t check the status. Reload the page.

SlotModal.title: Appointment duration
SlotModal.subtitle: Starts: {start}. Keep the default length or change it?

PatientBooking.title: Book appointment
PatientBooking.subtitle: Pick a specialist, day, and free slot.
PatientBooking.pastDay: You can’t book a day that already passed.

AdminPatients.title: Patients
AdminPatients.subtitle: Public patient account data. You can promote someone to specialist from here.
AdminPatients.promoteHint: Enter specialty and license number. Activate now or send to the approval queue.
AdminPatients.promoteActiveSuccess: Patient promoted and activated as specialist.
AdminPatients.loadError: Could not load the patient list.

AdminMail.title: Test emails
AdminMail.subtitle: Fire Resend templates (smoke, appointment, transfer) against real bookings.
AdminMail.missingKey: RESEND_API_KEY is missing in the environment.
AdminMail.toPlaceholder: empty = your admin email / patient by template

ClinicalHistory.title: Clinical history
ClinicalHistory.subtitle: Basic demographics and medical background. You can fill this anytime; specialists can update it too.
ClinicalHistory.incompleteBody: Important details are missing (date of birth, background…). Complete it so your specialist can care for you better.

MedicalFiles.subtitle: Upload labs, imaging, or other records. Append-only — files cannot be deleted.
MedicalFiles.visitHint: Defaults to the most recent visit. You can pick another.
MedicalFiles.noVisits: This patient has no visits yet. Use “General chart” or book an appointment first.
MedicalFiles.pickVisit: Pick a visit to tag this document.
MedicalFiles.label: Label (optional)
MedicalFiles.formats: PDF, JPG, PNG, WEBP, DOC or DOCX · max size per server policy
MedicalFiles.appendOnly: Append-only archive: documents cannot be removed.
